memory_policy.note: Prior-attempt memory is a bounded LRU cache, not the complete history. It holds at most `capacity` entries; `total_attempts` attempts exist so far. List in `used_memory` the iteration numbers of the shown entries you actually relied on (empty if none). Cited entries are kept; the least recently used uncited entries are evicted first.

scope_policy.note: A patch may change at most one of the public data operations in app/db.py: get_note, list_notes, create_note, update_note, delete_note. Private helpers (names starting with _) and module-level code such as imports and SCHEMA may change freely. A change to any other file counts as one operation. Patches that change more than one operation are rejected without testing (status scope_exceeded). Propose the single most valuable optimization within this limit.

objective: Reduce median-of-repetition mean request latency while preserving the complete notes API contract and durability.
